task_zh: 理解 Qwen3-8B 在特定硬件上表现缓慢的原因，并与其他模型进行比较。

A.title: 为什么 Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L 在 LM Studio 中于拥有 32GB RAM 的 TitanXP 上运行缓慢？
A.body:
我看到一份 2025 年 5 月的报告，其中一位用户在 LM Studio 中，于配备 TitanXP GPU（12GB VRAM）和 32GB RAM 的系统上运行了 Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L。但用户遇到了非常缓慢且奇怪的行为。考虑到 12GB VRAM 对于较大的量化模型来说有些受限，我想知道瓶颈是否可能与 VRAM 限制有关，或者 LM Studio 如何处理这种量化类型。

是否有人在类似硬件上尝试运行过 Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L 并注意到性能问题？LM Studio 对 Q6_K_L 量化的支持是否存在已知的怪癖，可能导致像 TitanXP 这样的 GPU 出现性能下降或不稳定？任何关于设置或变通方法的实际建议都将受到赞赏。

B.title: 为什么 Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L 在 LM Studio 的 TitanXP 设置中如此缓慢且奇怪？
B.body: 我看到一份 2025 年 5 月的详细用户报告，关于在 LM Studio 中，于配备 TitanXP GPU（12GB VRAM）和 32GB RAM 的系统上运行带有 Q6_K_L 量化的 Qwen3-8B。用户描述该模型运行得极其缓慢，对“Sat Hi”之类的简单提示需要超过 14 秒才能响应。更奇怪的是，当提示“Hello”时，模型开始解决一个与输入无关的勾股定理问题。有趣的是，一个更大的 Mistral Nemo Instruct 12B 模型（Q4_K_S 量化）在同一硬件上运行得快得多。这引出了几个问题：Q6_K_L 量化或 LM Studio 配置是否可能导致这些性能和行为问题？Qwen3-8B 在 TitanXP GPU 上的运行时是否存在已知的怪癖？是否有人在 Qwen3-8B 或可比模型中观察到类似的延迟或意外的数学计算？分享您的设置细节或故障排除技巧可能有助于弄清楚这是否是硬件、软件或模型相关的瓶颈。

english_A.title: Why does Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L run slowly on a TitanXP with 32GB RAM in LM Studio?
english_A.body:
I've come across a report from May 2025 where a user ran Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L in LM Studio on a system with a TitanXP GPU (12GB VRAM) and 32GB of RAM, but experienced very slow and odd behavior. Given that 12GB VRAM is somewhat limited for larger quantized models, I wonder if the bottleneck might be related to VRAM constraints or how LM Studio handles this quantization type.

Has anyone else tried running Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L on similar hardware and noticed performance issues? Are there known quirks with LM Studio's support for Q6_K_L quantization that could cause slowdowns or instability on GPUs like the TitanXP? Any practical advice on settings or workarounds would be appreciated.

english_B.title: Why is Qwen3-8B Q6_K_L so slow and odd in LM Studio on a TitanXP setup?
english_B.body: I came across a detailed user report from May 2025 about running Qwen3-8B with Q6_K_L quantization in LM Studio on a system with a TitanXP GPU (12GB VRAM) and 32GB RAM. The user describes the model as incredibly slow, taking over 14 seconds to respond to simple prompts like "Sat Hi". Even stranger, when prompted with "Hello," the model started solving a Pythagorean theorem problem that wasn’t part of the input. Interestingly, a larger Mistral Nemo Instruct 12B model (Q4_K_S quantization) ran much faster on the same hardware. This raises several questions: Could the Q6_K_L quantization or LM Studio configuration be causing these performance and behavior issues? Are there known quirks with Qwen3-8B’s runtime on TitanXP GPUs? Has anyone else observed similar delays or unexpected math computations in Qwen3-8B or comparable models? Sharing your setup details or troubleshooting tips might help clarify if this is a hardware, software, or model-related bottleneck.
